items.title: Commercial Account Executive
items.location_text: San Francisco, Austin, New York City
items.description: Perplexity is seeking a highly motivated and skilled Commercial Account Executive to join our small but mighty Enterprise team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving new business growth across small and mid-sized organizations, converting product-led demand into committed Enterprise relationships, and building Perplexity's footprint across thousands of high-potential accounts. This role is ideal for proactive sales professionals who thrive at the intersection of technology and business, and who want to help shape Perplexity's commercial motion from the ground up. RESPONSIBILITIES - Drive new business by prospecting, pitching, and closing Perplexity Enterprise solutions with small and mid-sized organizations - Convert existing self-serve customers into Enterprise relationships, and land net-new logos through outbound, inbound, and product-led signals - Diligently research prospects, develop account strategies, and execute outreach campaigns tailored to company and industry needs - Conduct high-impact product demonstrations and respond to technical inquiries across Perplexity's full product suite - Lead client engagement through the entire sales cycle, from initial presentation, technical evaluation, negotiation, to closing and onboarding - Quickly diagnose account potential, qualify in and out with discipline, and partner with Enterprise AEs when an account warrants a larger motion - Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure customer satisfaction and solution fit - Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Perplexity's platform, industry trends, and competitor landscape - Meet or exceed individual and team revenue, logo, and activity targets on a monthly and quarterly basis - Maintain accurate records of pipeline and account activity using CRM tools QUALIFICATIONS - Full-cycle SaaS sales experience with a strong track record of closing new business - Proven record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a high-growth environment - Skilled at running efficient sales cycles and tailoring messaging to different buyer personas and decision makers - Proven success outbound prospecting into small and mid-sized organizations - Exceptional written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to executives and technical buyers - Adept at identifying client pain points and mapping solutions that drive business value - Ability to collaborate effectively with both cross-functional teams and technical stakeholders - Experience with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce) - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

items.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Digital Native Business
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As an Enterprise Account Executive for Digital Native Business based in Tokyo, you'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI technology across Japan's fastest-moving technology companies. This is a greenfield, new business role: you'll build your territory from the ground up, owning the full sales cycle from first outbound touch to close across Japan's internet services, gaming, e-commerce, SaaS, fintech, and media companies. You'll work directly with founders, technical leaders, and product teams to help them build with Anthropic's AI as a core part of their products and operations. Key responsibilities Own and exceed revenue targets by winning net-new logos across Japan's digital native companies, including internet services, gaming, e-commerce, SaaS, fintech, and media Build a greenfield territory from scratch: develop your own account list, generate pipeline through self-sourced outbound prospecting, and create repeatable plays for landing new accounts Run fast, consultative sales cycles with founders, CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Engineering, and Heads of AI, positioning Claude as the foundation for AI-powered products and competitive differentiation Land new accounts quickly and set them up for expansion, working closely with technical buyers and developer teams who evaluate hands-on Orchestrate internal teams (Product, Engineering, Applied AI, Partnerships) to win technical evaluations and accelerate time to production for customers building on our models Preferred qualifications 8+ years of sales experience in Japan with a clear track record as a hunter: consistently winning net-new logos and generating the majority of your own pipeline through outbound prospecting Experience selling to digital native, internet, or high-growth technology companies, and comfort engaging technical buyers such as engineering and product leaders, not just business stakeholders A track record of opening greenfield territories or segments with little existing brand presence, building pipeline and closing revenue from zero Proven experience exceeding revenue targets driven primarily by new business, with the ability to manage high-velocity cycles alongside larger strategic deals Strong commercial instincts for usage-based and consumption models, and the ability to connect product adoption to revenue growth A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality. You are a true team player who thrives in ambiguous, startup-like environments A strategic, analytical approach to territory and account prioritization combined with high-energy, persistent execution A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and responsibly for broad benefit Excellent communication skills in both Japanese and English What we offer Competitive base salary and commission structure commensurate with experience Equity participation Comprehensive benefits package Hybrid work model with flexibility Access to cutting-edge AI technology and world-class research team Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a highly motivated, self-starter first Revenue Partnerships hire based in the Middle East who is passionate about AI technology and how it is changing businesses. We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetization opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology and solutions. In this role you will: - Actively seek out, identify, qualify, and build a sales pipeline through partnerships with Global/Regional System Integrators, Cloud Providers, Value-Added Resellers (VARs), consulting firms and Technology Partners. - Collaborate with our Enterprise Sales team to close deals and consistently exceed monthly, quarterly, and yearly sales targets. - Establish and nurture strong partnerships that drive business growth and create new opportunities. - Serve as the primary point of contact for all partner-related initiatives within the Regional Sales team. - Oversee partner relationships at the regional level while maintaining alignment with global strategies. items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, leader européen des paris sportifs, est bien plus qu’un simple site de jeux en ligne. Proposant également du Poker, des courses hippiques et des jeux de Casino dans plusieurs pays et continents, c’est une entreprise inspirante et tournée vers l’avenir. Chaque jour apporte de nouveaux défis dans un environnement moderne et dynamique. Acteur influent de la tech, avec une croissance forte et continue au fil des années, nous croyons en l’innovation grâce à la diversité et à l’inclusion et encourageons chacun à exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Avec notre équipe multiculturelle, nous offrons une expérience de jeu optimale, sûre et responsable, soutenue par une technologie de pointe. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 Chez Betclic, le succès repose sur des équipes passionnées et engagées. Voici pourquoi vous aimerez travailler avec nous: 💡 Un environnement international et créatif où chaque projet est une opportunité d’innover 📈 Une hypercroissance qui apporte chaque jour de nouveaux défis et opportunités de développement 🏡 Un bon équilibre vie pro et vie perso avec du télétravail flexible et une attention particulière au bien-être 🌟 Une ambiance unique et conviviale avec 1 600 collaborateurs répartis dans 5 pays et un siège basé à Bordeaux Vous êtes passionné de sport et de tech? Rejoignez nous et participez à façonner l’avenir du jeu en ligne. ENTER THE GAME 🎮 En tant que stagiaire au sein de l'équipe Growth - Casino , vous reporterez au Casino Growth Manager. Ce stage vous permettra de découvrir les dynamiques d’un environnement international au rythme soutenu tout en contribuant à des initiatives marketing à fort impact et en développant vos compétences en marketing digital et Ops. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 Dans ce rôle, vous serez amené à: Contribuer à la préparation et au déploiement d’activations marketing destinées à développer l’engagement des joueurs Casino, en veillant à la cohérence des dispositifs avec les objectifs de croissance. Suivre les résultats des campagnes à l’aide des principaux indicateurs de performance, préparer des synthèses et partager les enseignements utiles avec les équipes concernées. Participer à l’identification de pistes d’amélioration en croisant les performances observées, les retours des joueurs et les pratiques du marché. Contribuer à la construction et au suivi du calendrier des activations mensuelles, en coordonnant les étapes de préparation avec les équipes CRM, Design et marketing local. Accompagner la mise en avant des nouveaux jeux et fonctionnalités : préparation des supports, coordination des prises de parole et suivi des premiers résultats. Participer aux tests et à l’amélioration des parcours et outils marketing, puis documenter les éventuels ajustements nécessaires avant leur déploiement. Réaliser une veille sur les initiatives de croissance et les activations concurrentes afin d’alimenter les réflexions de l’équipe Casino. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 Nous recherchons des étudiants passionnés et curieux, qui apportent bienveillance et enthousiasme à l’équipe. Ce stage est fait pour vous si: Vous préparez actuellement un Master en Business, Marketing ou Digital Marketing (ou équivalent). Vous avez au moins 6 mois d’expérience (stage, alternance) sur des fonctions digitales, e-commerce, start up (ou équivalent). Vous êtes curieux des technologies, plateformes et outils digitaux. Vous êtes organisé, motivé pour apprendre et proactif dans la résolution de problèmes. Vous êtes à l’aise avec Excel et motivé pour développer vos compétences sur les outils et plateformes marketing. Le processus de recrutement dure en général entre 2 et 4 semaines afin de garantir la meilleure expérience possible. Un contrat d’apprentissage n’est pas possible sur ce rôle. Localisation: Bordeaux 📍 Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX

items.title: Strategic Data & Licensing Partnerships
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Strategic Data & Licensing Partnerships Negotiator on the Strategic Data & Licensing Partnerships team, you will drive the acquisition of premium content and negotiate complex agreements to secure high-value data and content for AI training, RAG, and distribution. Your work will enable Mistral AI to access quality, relevant sources while building long-term relationships with publishers, universities, research institutions, and data providers. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align content sourcing with Mistral AI’s strategic interests, ensuring innovative and ethical use of data. This role is for a results-driven negotiator who thrives in high-stakes deal-making and understands the intersection of AI, academic content, and ethical data practices. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Build and manage a pipeline of high-quality content (STEM, academic, robotics, multimedia) while vetting providers for legal and business compliance. - Negotiate complex, multi-pronged agreements (licensing, revenue-sharing, co-development) with publishers, universities, and research institutions. - Develop long-term partnerships that promote fair compensation and sustainability for content creators and owners. - Collaborate with internal teams (Science, Product, Go To Market) to align procurement with their objectives and evaluate "make vs. buy" options. - Provide regular reports and analytics on procurement activities to support data-driven decision-making. - Design programs that foster ethical and scalable content sourcing, balancing internal development with external licensing. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Proven track record negotiating and closing complex deals ($10M+), including licensing, revenue-sharing, or co-development agreements. - Deep understanding of AI training data ecosystems and the ability to translate technical needs into business terms. - Legal acumen in data acquisition and content licensing, including knowledge of global copyright laws. - Strong STEM background (degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field) and passion for academic content. - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience negotiating with C-level stakeholders. - Business acumen in market analysis and financial modeling (e.g., DCF analysis). - Fluency in English and French; additional languages (e.g., German) are a plus. - Existing network in publishing, academic, or research communities or experience with AI training data (pretraining, RAG, synthetic data). WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. As a Prime Sales Trader on the Institutional Prime Trading team, you'll help grow one of Coinbase's most strategically important businesses by delivering best-in-class execution and liquidity solutions to the world's most sophisticated institutional clients. Our clients include asset managers, hedge funds, VCs, family offices, pensions, and endowments across both crypto-native and traditional finance. You'll drive trading volume, deepen counterparty relationships, and shape how institutional clients experience Coinbase's execution services across spot and derivatives markets. items.location_text: San Francisco, New York City, Seattle
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments as well as other OpenAI products worldwide. We operate across the full funnel - from awareness and acquisition through activation, retention, and expansion - using a combination of global performance marketing, AI-powered workflows, in-product optimization, insights, experimentation, and creative ops engineering. Our Growth Marketing team is a rapidly scaling functional area, accelerating growth by connecting out-of-product and in-product experiences into seamless journeys that acquire, retain, and re-engage users, unlocking ChatGPT’s transformative potential in users’ daily lives. We work cross-functionally with product, engineering, design, data science, finance, and marketing to unlock scalable growth levers and deliver measurable impact across diverse markets. This team thrives on rapid testing, rigorous measurement, and creative problem solving, all while keeping user value at the center of our decision-making. ABOUT THE ROLE In this role, you will build and run the creative and advertising operations system that powers OpenAI’s paid marketing programs. You will connect Creative and Growth Marketing teams, establish clear processes for producing and launching high-quality ads, and keep the operational details behind paid campaigns organized, accurate, and scalable. You will help translate growth priorities into creative briefs and testing roadmaps, coordinate assets and approvals across internal teams and external partners, and turn performance results into clear next steps. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Build and manage the end-to-end paid creative operating system, including creative intake, briefing, production, asset delivery, approvals, trafficking, launch, reporting, and iteration. - Serve as the day-to-day connector between Creative, Brand, Growth Marketing, agencies, and production partners, keeping priorities and timelines clear and on track. - Partner with Growth Marketing to build and maintain creative testing roadmaps, translating campaign goals, audience insights, and performance data into briefs, hypotheses, test plans, and clear success metrics. - Develop and maintain the tools and processes that keep creative production organized, including asset libraries, production calendars, naming conventions, tagging, version control, specifications, and documentation. - Track creative test results, document learnings, and partner with Growth Marketing and Creative to identify what is working, what needs to change, and what should be tested next. - Continuously improve workflows, templates, reporting, and automation to increase creative throughput, reduce errors, and make paid marketing operations more efficient and reliable. As with all meaningful inventions, mass adoption requires value prop refining, education, and trust building. Scaling a new asset class requires both creativity (art) and hardcore discipline (science). We are building our growth team, a cross-functional team of artists and scientists to tackle the uncharted territory of scaling events trading. As one of the first dedicated performance marketers on the team, you'll help shape and structure our paid growth strategy by refinding and iterating our value props and messaging in. items.title: Customer Support Specialist ll
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Customer Success Agent you will serve as a primary subject matter expert for Coinbase’s products, providing world-class service and support to our most valued customers. You’ll join a team of customer focused support professionals who know their performance is essential to Coinbase achieving its mission. We’re looking for an individual who has a passion for making the customer experience seamless and phenomenal. What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties): Responsible for providing support for high-profile Coinbase customers across multiple channels (phone, messaging & email) by investigating, troubleshooting and resolving customer issues. Use all available resources to ensure high standards are met and work is carried out in the most efficient manner. Be a trusted advisor, listen and empathize so the customer knows they are valued. Ensure their voices are heard through accurate issue tracking and upstream solutions. Take ownership and use critical thinking to find the root cause and solve the customer issue on the first contact. Where this is not possible, ensure all defects are logged appropriately. Seek opportunities to add value for customers through education, proactivity and clear expectation setting. You will be responsible for providing best in class customer support, handling customers proactively to mitigate issues, handling contacts through to resolution, and collaborating across teams of subject matter specialists to fix issues with urgency. Model an investigative mentality: utilize data and customer feedback to help address critical customer issues at the root cause and eliminate defects in the customer experience. Proactively identify customer needs before they become an issue to simplify the customer experience, reduce friction, and strengthen trust in Coinbase. Champion clear communication with internal and external partners to align on solutions and drive results. Develop a deep understanding of Coinbase products and ongoing changes in the macro crypto environment so you can guide customers to navigate the quickly moving and ever changing crypto world and unlock additional features, services, and products that benefit their unique profile. What we look for in you (ie. job requirements): This role requires full-time, in-office presence, five days a week. Willingness to work nights and weekends to support the 24/7 nature of cryptocurrency markets. Motivated by Coinbase’s mission and creating a seamless experience for our highest value customers. Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in a customer service or support role in a fast paced environment including working with high value customers. Basic knowledge of blockchain, web3, staking, ROI/staking rewards, self-custody, and/or crypto. Flexible and adaptable to meet the evolving needs of a high-growth and fast paced organization. Fantastic communication and relationship management skills, passion for assisting customers to use Coinbase products successfully, and an eagerness to create a community of high value Coinbase power users. Nice to haves: Experience at crypto exchanges or in financial services, ideally in payments, trading operations or technical support. High level of proficiency in cryptocurrency and Coinbase products Experience in training and/or quality auditor roles Experience in Banking, Wealth Management, Corporate Finance, Asset Management or FinTech Understanding of Google apps, JIRA, Salesforce Service Cloud, or Amazon Connect. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. US Applicants: View Employee Rights , Know Your Rights , and E-Verify Notice of Participation. Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. items.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Platform Intelligence
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Platform Intelligence turns each new Claude model's abilities into API features that developers can build on. Our goal is to make the full intelligence of each model available through the API. We own the capabilities that shape what Claude can do for developers: tool use, built-in tools such as web search and code execution, thinking controls, structured outputs, and the memory, files, and skills APIs. We also run the API side of every Claude model launch, including its safety features and controls. That means getting the API ready for each new model, coordinating with research, safeguards, product, and cloud partners, and making sure the model, its features, the SDKs, and the docs all ship together on launch day. The work sits where research meets product. We work with new models before they are public. When a model gains a new ability, we work out what it should look like as an API, build it, and ship it to developers on our own platform and on cloud platforms. Those decisions shape how developers first use each model. We also own API versioning and the evals that tell us a capability works in production. What you'll do You'll lead the design, build, and operation of API capabilities used by developers around the world. You'll work with research to understand what a new model can do and turn that into an interface that is simple, durable, and hard to misuse. You'll lead the API side of new model launches. You'll plan the work, track readiness across teams, resolve the issues that come up late, and see the launch through on the day. Between launches, you'll make the next one faster and safer. You'll set technical direction for work that spans several teams, write clear design proposals, review API designs from other teams, and mentor engineers on the team. Representative projects Lead API readiness for a Claude model launch, so that every feature works on day one across our API, SDKs, docs, and cloud partners Take a new model ability from research prototype to public API feature, from interface design to production rollout Build and operate tools such as web search and code execution under real traffic Automate the manual parts of a model launch Build the evals that catch a capability regression before a launch You might be a good fit if you: Have led technical projects that spanned several teams, from design through launch and operation Have designed and operated production distributed systems where correctness, latency, and availability all matter Have strong product sense and care about API design and developer experience Make sound technical decisions with incomplete information, as models and priorities change close to a launch Explain tradeoffs clearly to research, product, and go-to-market partners, including non-engineers Make the engineers around you better through design review and mentoring Use AI tools as a regular part of how you design, build, and review software Care about the societal impacts of your work and Anthropic's mission to build safe, beneficial AI Strong candidates may also have: Building public APIs, SDKs, or developer platforms Working with large language models, including tool use, agents, or evals Running launches or migrations with fixed deadlines and many dependent teams Building tools for agents, such as search or code execution Storage, memory, or context systems at scale Integrating with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Location Preference: Preference will be given to candidates based in NY, SEA, SF or the Bay Area given the current location of team. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement to turn complex financial and business questions into reliable data products, clear analyses, and actionable recommendations. You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will combine the technical depth of analytics engineering with strong analytical judgment and close partnership with Strategic Finance. Your work will serve both executive reviews and the teams making day-to-day business decisions. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Define and maintain trusted metrics and analytical datasets for revenue, usage, customer performance, compute consumption, and margin, with clear definitions and appropriate product, customer, and cohort detail. - Build automated dashboards and recurring reporting that help Finance leaders and operating teams understand performance, spot changes, and prioritize investigation. - Explain movements in business results and variances against expectations by examining underlying drivers, validating data quality, and distinguishing evidence from assumptions. - Translate ambiguous questions about growth, retention, monetization, pricing, and resource efficiency into structured analyses and practical recommendations. - Partner with forecasting specialists and Finance to provide reliable inputs, driver analyses, and scenario assumptions for forecasts and long-range plans. - Work with Data Engineering to improve the quality and usability of underlying data, and develop reusable analytical models and workflows that reduce manual effort. - Communicate findings clearly, align stakeholders on trade-offs, and follow through to understand whether the analysis or data product improved the decision. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Have strong SQL and analytical data-modeling skills, and experience turning large, complex datasets into reliable analyses and reusable data products. - Can reason carefully about metrics, cohorts, denominators, measurement changes, and uncertainty, and investigate whether an unexpected result reflects the business or the data. - Have built dashboards or recurring reporting used by business partners, and can explain the decisions they enabled. - Bring sound business judgment and can independently scope an ambiguous problem, prioritize the work, and deliver an end-to-end solution. - Communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively with Finance, data scientists, engineers, and other business partners. - Can use Python or a comparable analytical tool to investigate data and automate repetitive work. items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the Team & Role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood has been tapped as the brokerage and initial trustee for Trump Accounts, and is working alongside BNY and The U.S. Department of Treasury to develop and operate the program, which aims to expand market access for the next generation of Americans. In this role, you will help build a world-class, intuitive platform, leveraging Robinhood’s industry-leading financial technology to deliver a standalone web and app experience for this historic national initiative. The Government Products team focuses on building and scaling systems that support long-term investing and account management for millions of customers. This team works closely with product, data, and infrastructure partners to deliver reliable, secure, and intuitive experiences. You will help shape systems that enable customers to plan for their financial future with confidence! As a Staff Backend Engineer , you will serve as a foundational technical leader for this 0-to-1 initiative. You will be responsible for designing and building the critical backend architecture, pipelines, and complex cross-functional integrations required to interface securely with government systems. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you will directly shape a platform built to serve millions of future customers This role is based in our New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What You'll Do Lead the technical design, architectural strategy, and implementation of a brand-new, standalone backend infrastructure optimized for security, reliability, and scale. Design secure data pipelines and robust APIs to integrate government-backed registries, employer contribution frameworks, and institutional banking systems. Guide engineering teams across Robinhood's broader brokerage ecosystem, fostering technical excellence, setting high bar code standards, and mentoring senior engineers. Partner closely with Product, Security, Legal, and external stakeholders to navigate the unique protections and technical compliance protocols of a highly regulated government contract. Own backend stability and performance tuning ahead of initial high-volume user rollouts and the general public launch. What You Bring 8+ years of software engineering experience with a proven track record of operating as a principal or staff-level engineer, driving multi-year technical vision, long-term architecture, and strategic direction for large-scale distributed systems. Advanced mastery-level proficiency in designing, building, and maintaining high-throughput, low-latency distributed infrastructure and secure data pipelines using Python or Go. Deep expertise in domain modeling, microservices architecture, and building highly reliable APIs capable of orchestrating complex cross-functional data flows across multiple engineering domains. Demonstrable execution in a zero-to-one product space, navigating high levels of technical ambiguity, setting foundational engineering patterns, and systematically de-risking complex technical blockers. Experience serving as a primary technical point of contact across an entire organization, with a strong commitment to raising the engineering bar by sponsoring and mentoring senior engineers. Millions of people and teams adopt Perplexity and Computer on their own, and the Growth team owns the loops that turn that adoption into lasting usage and revenue. We're hiring a Growth GTM Engineer to build the systems that turn product usage into revenue and turn self-serve usage into enterprise pipeline. You'll turn first-party Computer and Enterprise usage into account-level signals. You'll ship the in-product paths that capture sales intent, and build and validate those signals with data science. Alongside product engineers, you ship production code, instrument the product and run experiments. You'll partner closely with Revenue Operations, who own Salesforce, CPQ, routing and sales reporting. Tech Stack: TypeScript | Next.js | React | Python | PostgreSQL | Snowflake | Eppo | AWS WHY PERPLEXITY IS DIFFERENT - Craftsmanship. We build high quality, tasteful products targeting both the AI native and AI curious. - Ownership. You identify the problem, design the solution and ship it. - Entrepreneurship. We think like founders, act with urgency, and hustle to deliver for each other and our users. - Scholarship. Work among highly talented peers, pursuing knowledge and truth, upleveling ourselves, our teams, and our products. - Partnership. We amplify each others' strengths, break down silos, and give selflessly to help our colleagues deliver excellence. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role The Claude Partner Network is how consulting firms, systems integrators, and other services partners build practices around Claude. When a company chooses a partner, it wants to know which firms have done this work well, in its industry and for its use case. Specializations are how the program will give it: credentials showing that a partner has demonstrated expertise in a given domain area. As Partner Specializations Lead, you'll own this program end to end: the requirements a firm has to meet, the evidence review that decides who qualifies, the benefits that make a specialization worth earning, and the operating rhythm that keeps it credible year after year. Your job is to take an early framework into a structure that scales: opening it to thousands of partners, running evaluation cycles, and launching new specializations with cross-functional input. This role suits someone who likes owning a standard. You'll work with partner managers, operations, enablement, marketing, and industry teams who each hold a piece of the program, and with senior leaders at partner firms who care a great deal about the outcome. A specialization only means something if it's earned, so you'll need to be rigorous with evidence, consistent in your decisions, and firm and clear when the answer is no. Key responsibilities Own each specialization's requirements, evidence standards, and benefits, and keep them current as our products and the partner network change Run each evaluation cycle from invitation to decision: collect partner evidence, reconcile it against internal data, lead the review, and document every decision Make and defend qualification decisions, including borderline cases, and apply the standard consistently across firms of very different sizes Communicate outcomes to partner executives and their Anthropic account teams, including clear guidance for firms that did not qualify Open the program to the wider partner network, and recommend which specializations come next based on customer demand, partner readiness, and Anthropic's priorities Define the evidence standard for new specializations with Applied AI, Product, and industry go-to-market teams Coordinate the teams that deliver the program's benefits (marketing, the partner directory, field enablement, technical support) so that earning a specialization leads to something real Work with Partner Enablement so that partner learning paths and certifications support each specialization Build the operating rhythm: renewal, remediation periods, an appeals path, and the tracking and reporting that show whether the program is working Design the review process to scale, using Claude and automation so that routine steps don't depend on a person Write and maintain partner-facing guidance (program guide sections, FAQs, application materials), clear enough for a partner to know where it stands without asking us, and internal guidance for field teams Use program data to recommend where each requirement's bar should sit and when it should move, and bring those recommendations to partner leadership Minimum qualifications Experience owning an external-facing program with published requirements (a partner, channel, certification, accreditation, or similar program), including running at least one full evaluation, qualification, or renewal cycle Experience making qualification or eligibility decisions against a written standard and communicating those decisions, including declines, to senior external stakeholders Experience working with CRM or PRM data, such as Salesforce reports or a partner portal, as a regular part of your job Strong writing: able to produce clear program requirements, decision memos, and partner-facing guidance that need little editing Experience leading work to a fixed date across several teams you do not manage, such as operations, marketing, enablement, and field teams Work effectively where the process is still being built and the details are still changing Are excited about Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial Preferred qualifications Experience designing or running a partner competency, specialization, or credential program at a technology company Experience with services partners (systems integrators, consultancies) from either side: managing them at a vendor, or building a practice around a vendor's technology at a firm, and an understanding of how those firms decide where to invest their people SQL or BI-tool skills sufficient to pull and check your own program data Experience taking a program from its first launch to a repeatable operating cycle Experience launching a program publicly with marketing and communications partners Enough technical depth to judge whether a partner's evidence of a software or AI deployment holds up Experience working with customers in regulated or specialized industries, such as financial services, healthcare, or the public sector Experience designing partner benefits or incentives, and an understanding of how they change partner behavior Hands-on experience building AI workflows with Claude or similar tools, and curiosity about how AI changes professional services delivery The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $300,000 — $365,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. items.description: About the Team Financial Engineering (FinEng) builds the financial systems behind ChatGPT, Codex, and OpenAI’s API platform. These products serve people, developers, and businesses around the world. We make them easy to buy, use, and pay for. Our systems support everything from individual subscriptions to usage-based billing and complex enterprise agreements. We also build the foundations for how products are packaged, accessed, and used: product catalogs, SKUs and bundles, workspaces, entitlements, and usage metering. These systems connect what customers purchase to the capabilities they can access and the usage they can manage. That reach creates challenging engineering problems. We build services and data pipelines that handle large volumes of usage and transactions, keep payments, product access, and financial records consistent across systems, and adapt as products and pricing change. The same foundations must support a simple checkout and the detailed spending controls a large business needs. Your work will help teams launch new products faster and give customers confidence in what they are paying for. The work spans customer experiences, backend services, and data systems, with opportunities to influence technical design and see your work through to production. We’re hiring Staff+ engineers with strong backend experience. Experience in payments, billing, or financial systems is a strong plus, but not required. In this role, you will: - Design and build systems for purchasing, payments, subscriptions, and billing across OpenAI products and global markets. - Build product catalogs, SKUs, and bundles that let product teams launch new offerings and evolve how products are packaged. - Develop workspace and entitlement systems that connect purchases and subscriptions to product access for individuals and teams. - Keep charges and product access correct when requests are retried, updates arrive late, or another service fails. - Build metering systems, data pipelines, and APIs that turn large volumes of usage into accurate bills, timely spending information, and records that are easy to trace and verify. - Create reusable building blocks that let product teams launch new offerings, pricing, and payment options without rebuilding the foundations each time. - Make complex financial workflows simple for customers and internal teams, using customer feedback and experiments to improve the experience. - Scale and evolve live systems while protecting customer access, financial accuracy, performance, and security. - Own problems from early design through launch and operation, working with product, design, finance, and other engineering teams to make and test important technical decisions. Nice to Have - Experience with payments, subscriptions, pricing, billing, or other systems that manage customer purchases and revenue. - Experience with product catalogs, packaging and bundles, workspace management, entitlements, or usage metering. - Experience building financial or transaction systems at scale, checking that records match across systems, or supporting compliance and audits. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About Anthropic Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As the leader of Partner Services Delivery and Success within Partnerships at Anthropic, you will lead the global field delivery, partner success and partner health teams that make Claude deployments succeed at our customers when our partners build and run them. This is a senior leadership role on the Partnerships leadership team, reporting to the Global Head of Partnerships. A deployment starts with work the business wants an agent to do: a research process in a bank, claims handling at an insurer, engineering workflows in a retailer. A partner's engineers build it against the customer's own systems and data, evaluate it on real work rather than a demo, and put it live. If it holds, the customer builds the next ten themselves and the partner carries the pattern to the next customer in that industry. What good means is the same every time, whoever builds it: on time, on track, high quality, high customer satisfaction, and impact the customer can see in their own business. Holding that across thousands of deployments a year, almost none of which your own people build, is the job. This is a build, and it is a scaling problem. The function is new, the teams are mostly still to be hired, demand is growing far faster than any team can be hired against it, and the way we deploy agents is changing faster than a method written down in advance can keep up with. What you will own Deployment strategy and approached. Bringing the best ways to deploy Claude to our customers through partners: which deployment approaches we back, which partners we build them with, and how both change as the models and the use cases move. Field delivery. A global organisation across the Americas and international markets, which you hire, lead and grow. Our own people, in region, alongside the partner's team on live engagements: they run the delivery cadence, hold the work to date and quality, and are the first to know when something is going wrong. Most of the team sits here, and it is accountable for deployments landing on time and on track, to a high quality bar, with high customer satisfaction and impact the customer can see in their own business, against the customer's own deployment plan rather than a partner work order. items.title: Art Director, Research Team
items.description: About the Team OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world. This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning. About the Role OpenAI is seeking a hands-on Art Director to partner with the Research team on creative concepts, visual direction, and design. You’ll help define how research stories look and feel, developing ideas and carrying them into compelling visual work. Working directly with researchers, you’ll keep scientific accuracy and clarity central to the creative approach, while finding distinctive ways to capture people’s attention and imagination. You’ll collaborate with filmmakers, designers, and marketing and creative partners across web, social, film, editorial, and experiences. Your work may range from developing a visual concept and art directing collaborators to designing assets yourself. You’ll create treatments, references, and explorations that establish a clear direction, then help carry that direction through production and final delivery. This role suits a versatile art director with strong hands-on design craft, a distinct creative point of view, and an interest in AI research. You can move between the overall visual idea and the details of execution, build cohesive visual systems, and give collaborators clear, constructive feedback. You should be comfortable navigating ambiguity and adapting your approach to an evolving research agenda. Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com. 📐 About the role Imagine stepping into a role where your code directly empowers the world's largest enterprises to safely adopt superintelligence. As a software engineer, generative ai at WRITER, you'll be at the forefront of expanding human capacity by building the secure, scalable foundation that allows our generative AI solutions to thrive in complex corporate environments. The impact of this work is massive – for example, in the consumer packaged goods industry alone, our AI adoption is driving 69% revenue increases and 72% cost reductions. This role is designed for a well-rounded engineering generalist who leans heavily into generative AI while bringing a whole-systems mindset to architectural design. If you thrive on proactivity without red tape and love owning projects from proposal to deployment, you'll shape the future of AI and contribute to a product that’s changing how the world works. This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, New York City, or London hubs. You'll report to an engineering director or a senior engineering manager. We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role. 🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do - Design and develop robust, secure, and scalable generative AI services and applications using Python and modern frameworks to drive enterprise-wide transformation - Build and optimize high-performance, low-latency APIs and microservices to integrate advanced AI models and sophisticated agentic workflows into our core platform - Act as a whole-systems thinker by making meaningful system design decisions and owning the architecture of core platform components from initial proposal through production deployment - Implement and maintain responsive user interfaces using technologies like React and TypeScript to deliver intuitive user experiences and bridge the gap between backend services and frontend enablement - You'll build resilient systems, automate across the stack, and champion reliability best practices, directly enabling our ambitious product roadmap and ensuring our customers always have access to the powerful tools they need. This is a hybrid position, based out of our New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, or London hubs. You'll report to our director of engineering. Bring deep focus to one problem at a time, with the breadth to move between SRE, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Platform work over a quarter or two as the leverage shifts. Challenge the status quo and remove toil before adding features — automate operational tasks and infrastructure management with Python or Go, reject tools that don't fit the problem, and treat manual on-call work as a defect to be designed out, not a status quo to be staffed up. - Breadth across the stack. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com. 📐 About the role Design engineers sit at the intersection of design and engineering. As a design engineer at WRITER, you'll own the Writer Design System (WDS) — how it's built, how it's maintained, and how both humans and AI agents use it to ship product. This role matters more now than ever. AI coding agents write more of our production code, and they ship whatever they find. A design system that's incomplete or inconsistent doesn't just slow designers down; it gets compounded at scale by every agent that builds against it. You'll make sure WRITER's core UI library is complete and trustworthy enough to build on, working closely with the designers, PMs, and engineers who rely on it every day. You'll help shape the surfaces that define how our product feels to use, and help set the standard and process for how the EPD org ships product. This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Austin, New York City, Seattle, or London hubs. This role will be reporting to the Director of product design. We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role. 🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do - Own the Writer Design System (WDS) as your primary domain — agentify and maintain it, ensuring it's optimized for both humans and AI agents building with it - Design and build production-quality UI components and features, owning surfaces from sketch to ship - Ship design-led work that wouldn't survive an engineering backlog — polish passes, micro-interactions, and brand moments that make the product feel alive - Architect new primitives and extend the system's core components, shaping its technical direction while keeping documentation, examples, and libraries in sync across Figma, .md skills, and Storybook - Uphold the bar for front-end craft across accessibility, motion feel, consistency, and quality, ensuring accessibility is baked into every design system component - Help shape the design-to-code workflow, researching the latest tools and practices to unlock org-wide productivity and democratize workflows across the EPD organization - Partner with designers, PMs, and engineering leads to measure WDS adoption, close gaps, and make sure shipped features meet design system standards ⭐️ What you need - 4–8+ years building production frontends with TypeScript and React, with a track record of owning a system, platform, or surface end-to-end rather than individual features - Solid instincts for animation principles including easing curves, choreography, anticipation, follow-through, interruptibility, and perceived performance - Fluency in Figma at expert level — auto-layout, variants, variables, and code connect — and proficiency with design engineering technologies like framer-motion, gsap, and lottie for web-based animation - A demonstrable obsession with craft, backed by a portfolio, side projects, GitHub, or production work that includes systems-level work and not just feature work - Experience driving adoption of a design system or shared platform across an engineering org, with a track record of influencing technical or design direction beyond your immediate team - Experience with AI product surfaces — tool-call UIs, streaming responses, agent state, and dynamic UI rendering — and comfort navigating ambiguous, cross-team problems with good judgment about when to loop others in - A genuine commitment to WRITER's values of Connect, Challenge, and Own 🍩 Benefits & perks (US Full-time employees) - Generous PTO, plus company holidays - Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family - With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com. 📐 About the role Join WRITER's security team as a staff detection and response engineer and help protect the AI infrastructure that's transforming how the world works. You'll build sophisticated detection systems that identify attacks targeting our AI platform, training data, and model deployments while creating automated response capabilities that scale with our explosive growth. This isn't just traditional security work – you're defending cutting-edge AI/AGI systems against adversaries who are evolving their tactics as fast as AI itself advances. This role combines hands-on security engineering with strategic thinking to stay ahead of novel threats that don't exist in textbooks yet. You'll be the operational arm of our security function, translating threat intelligence into real-time detections, coordinating incident response across multiple teams, and hunting for sophisticated attacks across GPU clusters and distributed training environments. If you're excited by the challenge of securing systems that are fundamentally different from anything you've protected before, this is your opportunity to define what AI security engineering looks like at scale. You'll work closely with our AI Security research team, Cloud Infrastructure, Software Security Engineering, and AI researchers to build a defense-in-depth strategy that protects one of the most valuable AI platforms in the industry. The threats are real, the stakes are high, and the problems are intellectually fascinating. This role can be based out of our San Francisco or Seattle office, reporting to our head of security operations. We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role. 🦸🏻‍♀️ What you’ll do - Design and implement detection strategies that identify AI-specific threats including prompt injection, model extraction, data poisoning, adversarial examples, and unauthorized access to training datasets or model weights across our distributed infrastructure - Build automated response playbooks and orchestration workflows that contain threats without human intervention, creating self-healing security systems that reduce mean time to response from hours to minutes while automatically remediating compromised inference endpoints - Lead security incident response coordination across all teams (Cloud, AppSec, Enterprise, AI Security) when AI infrastructure or models are compromised, conducting forensic investigations on training pipeline attacks and model manipulation attempts while drafting clear incident communications for engineering and executive leadership - Hunt proactively for sophisticated threats across GPU clusters and training infrastructure by analyzing model outputs for signs of compromise, reproducing AI-specific vulnerabilities from security research, and identifying visibility gaps in distributed training environments before adversaries exploit them - Build detection-as-code frameworks with version control and automated deployment, onboard telemetry from AI training infrastructure and inference endpoints, and create dashboards that track model security metrics, GPU utilization patterns, and access to sensitive research data - Collaborate cross-functionally as the operational security partner for all teams – translating AI Security's threat research into production detections, monitoring Cloud Infrastructure's GPU clusters for threats, detecting customer-impacting incidents for Software Security Engineering, and enabling responsible AI development through security guardrails - items.title: Counsel, AI Safety & Cyber Incident Response
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Legal team helps address the cutting-edge legal questions that arise from developing and deploying advanced AI. The Security and Public Sector Legal team helps protect OpenAI’s technology, systems, data, and people and supports the safe and responsible use of our tools. We work closely with technical and operational teams to provide practical advice on novel, consequential, and fast-moving issues. About the Role We are seeking a counsel to help lead legal responses to cybersecurity and AI safety incidents. This is an opportunity to bring deep incident response expertise to some of the hardest questions in AI, and help build the legal frameworks and practices for answering them. You will advise on complex cybersecurity incidents, from discovery through to resolution, and also help develop our response to incidents involving the safety of our models and tools. AI safety incident response is a new and rapidly evolving legal practice area. Your work will help define how frontier AI companies investigate and respond to safety events such as unexpected model behavior, degradation of safeguards, harmful uses of our services, and potential harm to third parties—often where established legal standards do not yet exist. Working directly with Security, Safety, Product, Engineering, and colleagues across Legal, you will advise on consequential decisions where established approaches may offer little guidance. We are looking for a practical, dynamic lawyer who can turn incomplete information into clear recommendations, exercise sound judgment on novel questions, and follow matters through to resolution. You will help establish the facts, assess risks, and guide investigations, communications, remediation, and reporting. You will also turn lessons from individual incidents into durable response processes, helping further develop a legal function that evolves alongside the technology. This role is based in Washington, D.C. or San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will be: - Serving as legal lead on assigned cybersecurity and AI safety incidents, coordinating fact development, legal analysis and advising, cross-functional escalation, and follow-through with the response team. - Working with investigators to understand incident scope, attack paths, root cause, and affected systems and data, and potential third-party impacts, while helping teams distinguish established facts from gaps in the evidence. - Managing outside counsel and third party service provider engagements necessary to incident response. - Serving as key Legal point of contact for cross-functional teams. - Partnering with Privacy, Product, Regulatory, and other counsel to assess notification and reporting obligations, advise on timely customer and user communications, and coordinate third-party outreach and incident-related information sharing with industry peers and government partners. - Preparing concise incident updates and decision materials that distinguish established facts, uncertainties, options, and recommended next steps. - Developing severity-based escalation criteria, response playbooks, exercises, and clear decision and handoff processes for cybersecurity and AI safety incidents, adapting established practices to emerging model risks. - Supporting post-incident reviews, tracking agreed corrective actions, and turning lessons into practical improvements to safeguards and response processes. You might thrive in this role if you have: - A JD and a license or qualification to practice law in your jurisdiction. - 5+ years of relevant experience. - Relevant legal experience managing cybersecurity or privacy incident responses or comparable complex technology investigations at a technology company, law firm, or government agency, including work with technical teams, other counsel, and communications partners. - The ability to translate technical findings into practical legal advice, with a working understanding of technical information. - Sound judgment under time pressure, clear communication of uncertainty, and an understanding of when to act, seek specialist advice, or escalate. - Clear, concise writing and the ability to keep cross-functional teams aligned through changing facts and competing priorities. - Ownership of details and follow-through, paired with collaborative work with colleagues who bring different expertise. - A strong interest in the novel challenges of AI safety and a willingness to help develop new approaches. Direct AI incident experience is helpful; strong transferable incident response skills are welcome. - Availability to participate in time-sensitive incident response, including occasional work outside normal business hours. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
